Text: WHEN a pending points transaction is 24 hours old and the purchase was not returned, the loyalty service shall post the points to the member's balance.
Rationale: The 24-hour return window protects against points on returned goods.

Text: IF the POS cannot read the member QR code, THEN the POS shall let the cashier enter the member number manually.
Rationale: Cashiers need a fallback when the app screen is too dark to scan.

Text: IF a member requests a voucher with fewer than 500 posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the request.
Rationale: Minimum redemption in the programme terms.

Text: WHEN a member has more than 500 posted points, the customer mobile app shall show the Redeem button.
Rationale: Prompts members to redeem as soon as they can.

Text: The support console shall let support agents adjust a member's points with a reason code.
Rationale: Support resolves complaints about missing points.

Text: WHEN a support agent submits an adjustment above 5,000 points, the admin console shall require approval by a second support agent before posting it.
IF a member returns a purchase within 24 hours, THEN the loyalty service shall reverse the pending points transaction of that purchase.
